description: This file implements the CloneValue class, a method operation for the MiniLang framework that clones a GenericValue from one field to another within a method context.

classes.name: CloneValue
classes.description: A method operation that clones a GenericValue from a specified source field to a destination field within the method context.

classes.name: CloneValueFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of CloneValue from XML elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the clone operation by retrieving the source GenericValue from the environment map and copying it to the new field.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the clone-value operation.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a CloneValue object from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier 'clone-value' for this operation.
